title: Kissed with Roast Polish Wild Garlic Leaves
description:
A delicious and salty dish featuring the flavors of wild garlic leaves, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

This recipe is diabetic-friendly and serves four people, making it an excellent choice for a family meal.
instructions: Rinse the wild garlic leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Cut the roast beef into thin slices.
Season the roast beef with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the roast beef slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the seared roast beef to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the wild garlic leaves in the skillet for 1-2 minutes, or until crispy.
To assemble the dish, place a slice of the roast beef on each plate, top with toasted wild garlic leaves, and drizzle with lemon juice, balsamic vinegar, and crushed red pepper.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
